name: Signal Cluster S54+S56+S57: Asset Filtering + String Ops + Keywords
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER: Asset Filtering + String Ops + Keywords
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === is_asset_ref ===
is_spy = is_asset_ref(ticker='SPY')()
not_spy = logical_not()(is_spy)
spy_close = where(is_spy, close)

# === String operations on ticker symbol ===
ticker_str = src.s
alpha_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_alpha)(ticker_str)
upper_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_upper)(ticker_str)
ascii_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_ascii)(ticker_str)
alnum_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_alnum)(ticker_str)
digit_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_digit)(ticker_str)
lower_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_lower)(ticker_str)
numeric_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_numeric)(ticker_str)
decimal_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_decimal)(ticker_str)
space_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_space)(ticker_str)
title_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_title)(ticker_str)
printable_check = string_check(operation=StringCheckOperation.is_printable)(ticker_str)

# === String contains ===
has_s = string_contains(operation=ContainsOperation.contains, pattern="S")(ticker_str)
starts_s = string_contains(operation=ContainsOperation.starts_with, pattern="S")(ticker_str)
ends_y = string_contains(operation=ContainsOperation.ends_with, pattern="Y")(ticker_str)

# === Keyword match ===
kw = keyword_match(keywords=KeywordPatternSchema(
    patterns=["SPY", "QQQ"],
    case_sensitive=True, use_regex=False))(ticker_str)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='SPY Only Close',
    category='Filter',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spy_close)
